description: Deploy tools and which of their commands are production or preview (spec 5.3, owner-only). An entry is a list of words: it matches a command whose first word is the entry's first word and which contains each of the entry's other words (a word also matches itself followed by =value). Production is checked first; a deploy-tool command matching neither list is denied (gate-deploy-target, FRG-5). No preview is listed for now: Vercel's docs (checked 2026-10-27) say a new project's first deployment, and every --temporary one, goes to production whatever the command says, so no command form is known to stay a preview. Every deploy is an owner script until FRG-9 or FRG-12 proves one.
